description: Observe-only gap (K1 testing audit, 2026-09-04): reconciling a session against what actually happened has never been independently tested live. The athlete reports doing something different from what was planned today - the case coachPromptText.ts calls out explicitly (set actual alongside the outcome status). #973 collapsed week_plan/session_reconcile/plan_edit into one week_update action - expect updated to match (2026-09-13, #999 hardening round). Also found live in that same round: the session date was hardcoded to 2026-09-04 instead of {{TODAY}}, so this transcript had rotted into testing 'create an unplanned session on a day with no plan' instead of the real-session-reconcile case it was written for - the model correctly created a new session either way (that part was never a bug), but the transcript stopped exercising session_id matching against the real planned entry. Fixed with the same {{TODAY}}/{{TOMORROW}} token substitution #19 already uses for this exact class of date rot.
